lint_step.name: Lint canonical partition
lint_step.run:
set -eu
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/fm-lint"
bin/fm-lint.sh --partition "${{ matrix.partition }}of${{ strategy.job-total }}" \
  --telemetry "$RUNNER_TEMP/fm-lint/partition-${{ matrix.partition }}.tsv"

scope: Parsed workflow semantics only; GitHub Actions and ShellCheck not executed.
